data.title: PDS Biotechnology Retires Debt and Secures New Financing
data.description:
PDS Biotechnology ( (PDSB) ) has shared an update.

On September 14, 2026, PDS Biotechnology retired a $6 million Yorkville promissory note by paying about $4.6 million in outstanding principal and interest, eliminating the obligation without incurring early termination penalties and simplifying its balance sheet. On the same date, the company completed the initial closing of a PIPE financing, raising roughly $11.3 million through common stock and warrant issuances led by Nant Capital.

The PIPE proceeds are earmarked for debt repayment, working capital and continued clinical development, notably to advance lead immunocytokine PDS0301 into late-stage trials after encouraging National Cancer Institute Phase 2 data in metastatic colorectal cancer that is typically resistant to immunotherapy. As part of the financing, Nant and affiliates committed $10 million at the initial closing and a further $10 million upon a future milestone, while NantWorks secured a one-year exclusive right to negotiate a license for HPV-targeted therapy PDS0101, deepening the strategic relationship.

data.title: Cosma S.A. Secures Exclusive Polish Rights With Medical Cannabis Acquisition
data.description:
Cosma S.A. ( (PL:COS) ) has provided an announcement.

Cosma S.A. has signed an investment agreement to acquire 100% of IMP_C sp. z o.o., a Warsaw-based company active in the medical marijuana sector whose key assets are regulatory approvals and applications for cannabis-based medicinal products. IMP_C, to be renamed FULL SPECTRUM sp. z o.o., holds a registered medical cannabis flower product and three cannabis oil products in registration, positioning Cosma to expand its cannabinoid portfolio.

The transaction is structured in two stages, with Cosma already acquiring 50% of IMP_C and assuming full operational control and financing responsibilities while due diligence is conducted. The second stage, to be completed by end-2027 at the latest, is contingent on regulatory clearance for lawful import and distribution of the products in Poland and repayment of existing liabilities by the sellers.
